properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_claims_step_count_counts_each_step_once.rs, in the in_memory program. The class invariant, run over proof trial rung 2 and rung 1 imported from their fixtures: for EVERY concluded claim, proof_status.total_steps equals the distinct Inferences reachable below it through its holding lines (computed from the export's own CONCLUDES and PREMISE_OF edges and each top step's served verdict), never exceeds the design's Inference count, and confirmed_steps / unconfirmed_steps split that set. Named: rung 2 uniqueness 40 and theorem 41, rung 1 theorem at most 25. A hand-built claim with two lines sharing a step counts 3 not 4; it is proven when one line's own steps are all confirmed and only shown when the shared step is not; its proof_status carries `counts` saying what the numbers mean.
properties.findings: 3 passed in cargo dev-test (in_memory program, 781 of 783 passing there before the toolsnap regenerate, then the remaining one green), branch fix/a-claim-counts-each-step-once-and-the-walk-reaches-refuted-claims, commit d15132325. All three FAILED first on main 5a94e83: rung 2 "req:prop-uniqueness: total_steps 47 ... expected 40 distinct of the design's 48"; rung 1 "req:theorem-infinitely-many-primes: total_steps 26 ... expected 21 distinct of the design's 25"; the hand case read total_steps 4, confirmed 3.
properties.name: A claim's step count counts each step once (3 MCP tests, both proof trials)
